items.stem: This bridge ____ in 1998.
items.explanation: 桥是被建造的，1998 是过去时间，用一般过去时的被动语态 was built。built 是主动，is built 时态不符，has built 不能表被动。

items.stem: English ____ in more than fifty countries.
items.explanation: 英语是被使用的对象，用一般现在时被动语态 is spoken。speaks 是主动，spoke 与 has spoken 都不表被动。

items.stem: The homework ____ tomorrow.
items.explanation: 作业将被完成，用一般将来时被动 will be finished。其余三项都是主动形式，与作业的受动关系不符。

items.stem: A new hospital ____ in our town next year.
items.explanation: next year 提示将来时，医院是被修建的，用 will be built。is built 与 was built 时态不符，builds 是主动。

items.stem: The room ____ by us every day.
items.explanation: 房间被人打扫，every day 用一般现在时被动 is cleaned。cleans 与 cleaned 是主动，is cleaning 是进行时主动。

items.stem: These trees ____ last spring.
items.explanation: 树是被栽种的，last spring 是过去时间，用 were planted。are planted 时态不符，另两项是主动形式。

items.stem: —When ____ the school ____? —In 1950.
items.explanation: 学校被建成，被动语态疑问句用 was 提前加过去分词 built。did 后须接原形，is 与 has 时态或形式不符。

items.stem: The letter ____ to him yesterday.
items.explanation: 信是被寄出的，yesterday 用过去时被动 was sent。sent 是主动过去式，is sent 时态不符，sends 是第三人称单数。

items.stem: The boy ____ to look after his sister.
items.explanation: 男孩是被要求照顾妹妹的，用一般现在时被动 is asked。其余三项都是主动，与男孩的受动关系不符。

items.stem: The windows ____ already ____ by the students.
items.explanation: 完成时被动为 have been 加过去分词，主语复数用 have。has 配单数，缺 been 或改用 are 都不成立。

items.stem: The book ____ by many students now.
items.explanation: 书正被学生阅读，现在进行时被动为 is being read。is reading 是主动进行，reads 与 has read 都不表被动。

items.stem: The story ____ by children all over the world.
items.explanation: 故事是被喜爱的，用一般现在时被动 is loved。loved 是过去式主动，loves 与 loving 形式或语态不对。

items.stem: The man ____ is talking with our teacher is my father.
items.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人，从句缺主语，用关系代词 who。which 指物，whose 作定语，where 指地点。

items.stem: This is the book ____ I bought yesterday.
items.explanation: 先行词 book 指物，从句缺宾语，用 which。who 指人，whose 作定语，where 作状语。

items.stem: I like the girl ____ hair is long and black.
items.explanation: hair 与 girl 是所属关系，须用 whose 作定语。who、which、that 都不能表示所属。

items.stem: The house ____ we lived in ten years ago has been pulled down.
items.explanation: 先行词 house 指物，介词 in 后缺宾语，用 which。who 指人，whose 与 what 都不合此处。

items.stem: This is the best film ____ I have ever seen.
items.explanation: 先行词被最高级 the best 修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。which 与 who 在此结构中不适用。

items.stem: Do you know the man ____ is standing at the gate?
items.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人且在从句中作主语，用 who。which 指物，whose 作定语，when 指时间。

items.stem: I still remember the day ____ we first met.
items.explanation: 先行词 the day 表时间且从句不缺主宾，用关系副词 when。which 与 that 需在从句中作成分。

items.stem: This is the school ____ my mother works.
items.explanation: 先行词 school 表地点，从句成分完整，用关系副词 where。which 与 that 缺可替代的成分。

items.stem: The book ____ cover is red belongs to Mary.
items.explanation: cover 与 book 是所属关系，须用 whose。which、that 不能作定语表所属，who 只指人。

items.stem: He is the only person ____ can help you.
items.explanation: 先行词被 only 修饰且指人，关系代词用 who，也可用 that。which 指物，whose 与 what 不合。

items.stem: —Whose bag is this? —It ____ be Lily's. Hers is blue.
items.explanation: 包不是 Lily 的，因为她的包是蓝色，表示否定推测用 can't。must 表肯定推测，may 表可能，should 表应该。

items.stem: The light is on, so he ____ be at home.
items.explanation: 灯亮着是有力证据，表示肯定推测用 must。can't 表否定推测，mustn't 表禁止，needn't 表不必。

items.stem: She ____ be in the library. I saw her there just now.
items.explanation: 刚亲眼见到她在图书馆，是有把握的肯定推测，用 must。can't 与 might 都不是肯定判断。

items.stem: It ____ rain this afternoon. Take an umbrella with you.
items.explanation: 下午有可能下雨，表示不确定的可能性用 may。must 太肯定，can't 表否定，shouldn't 表不该。

items.stem: He ____ be a student. He looks too old.
items.explanation: 看起来太老，作否定推测用 can't。must 表肯定推测，may 表可能，should 表应当。

items.stem: —Where is Tom? —He ____ be in the playground. I'm not sure.
items.explanation: 说话人不确定，用 might 表较低可能性。must 与 should 语气过强，can't 是否定推测。

items.stem: The dictionary ____ be mine. My name is on it.
items.explanation: 名字写在上面是确凿证据，用 must 表肯定推测。can't 是否定推测，might 不肯定，needn't 表不必。

items.stem: You ____ be tired after the long walk.
items.explanation: 长途步行后疲惫是合理推断，用 must 表肯定。can't 与 might not 表否定，needn't 表不必。

items.stem: I don't know ____ he will come to the party.
items.explanation: 表示是否用 whether 引导宾语从句。that 用于陈述句，what 与 which 需在从句中作成分。

items.stem: Can you tell me ____ yesterday?
items.explanation: 宾语从句须用陈述语序，且 yesterday 用过去时，故为 what he did。其余三项倒装或时态错。

items.stem: I wonder ____ the meeting will begin.
items.explanation: 从句需要时间状语，用 when 引导。that 引导陈述句，what 与 which 需在从句中作主语或宾语。

items.stem: She asked me ____ I could help her.
items.explanation: 原句是 Can you help me，转从句用 if 表示是否。that 用于陈述句，另两项需有指代对象。

items.stem: Excuse me, could you tell me how old ____ ?
items.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序 how old he is。其余三项语序倒装或词序混乱。

items.stem: He told me that he ____ to Beijing twice.
items.explanation: 主句 told 是过去时，从句表示更早的经历用过去完成时 had been。has been 与 told 不呼应。

items.stem: I really don't know ____ to do next.
items.explanation: 疑问词加不定式作宾语，do 缺宾语，用 what。how 表方式，which 需选择范围，that 不合。

items.stem: Please tell me ____ you like the film or not.
items.explanation: 与 or not 搭配只能用 whether。if 不能与 or not 直接连用，that 与 what 都不表选择。

items.stem: 「他昨天告诉我的事很重要」的英语是（　）
options: Which he told me yesterday is important.
What did he tell me yesterday is very important.
That he told me yesterday are important.
What he told me yesterday is very important.
items.explanation: 主语从句用陈述语序 what he told me yesterday，谓语用单数 is。倒装、are 与 which 都不合。

items.stem: The reason ____ he was late is that he missed the bus.
items.explanation: 先行词 the reason 表原因，从句成分完整，用关系副词 why。which 与 what 需在从句中作成分。
